# Maxey0 for Claude Desktop

Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

**Installs from this repository.**

## Install

```
Drag dist/maxey0-0.3.0.mcpb into Claude Desktop.
```

The manifest declares the UV runtime, so Claude Desktop provisions Python and every dependency itself. The .dxt is the same bytes under the former extension.
